title: Group Therapy
description: group_by_length(words) returns a dictionary that maps each word length to the list of words with that length, in their original order.
hint: What happens to a key's existing list when the same key is assigned again?
explanation: `groups[key] = [word]` replaces the list every time, so only the last word of each length survives. Append to the existing list instead: `setdefault` (or `collections.defaultdict(list)`) creates the list only the first time.
